data.one_liner: Searchable single and multi-select dropdowns with accent-insensitive search and Material 3 theming.
data.what_it_does: Provides single and multiple selection searchable dropdown widgets for Flutter with built-in item creation, editing, and deletion. Uses a controller-driven state management approach and supports accent-insensitive searching, sorting, and Material 3 theming.
use_when: You need a dropdown component with real-time text searching and filtering.
Users need the ability to add, edit, or delete items directly from the dropdown list.
You require multi-selection with chips rendered inside the input box.
avoid_when: You only need a basic, non-searchable native dropdown menu where standard Flutter widgets suffice.
You are using a Flutter version older than 3.32.
strengths: Accent- and case-insensitive forgiving search out of the box.
Controller-driven state management using ChangeNotifier without needing GlobalKeys.
In-place add, edit, and delete operations with async callbacks and loading spinners.
weaknesses: Requires Flutter 3.32 or newer, which may be restrictive for older codebases.
Customizing complex layouts beyond provided settings may require custom row builders.
